shared_elements: human figures shown in profile facing right
justification: Both surfaces show a rightward-moving file of profile human figures together with horned quadrupeds, and in each case a person appears to lead or accompany the animals, which is a real but broadly generic correspondence. The manner of depiction is wholly different: A uses tiny flat silhouette pictograms with stick-like limbs, plus boats which have no counterpart, whereas B renders large, modelled, naturalistic figures with detailed hair, fleece and floral border bands absent from A.
